eps.o: In the summer of 2024, police respond to a 911 call in American Fork, Utah, to find Matt Restelli dead on the floor of his mother-in-law's house with multiple gunshot wounds. The case initially appears to be self-defense but soon becomes much more complicated.
A sexual assault survivor’s decades-long fight for justice takes an unexpected turn when her daughter helps reignite the case.

Talina Galloway disappears from Wagoner, Oklahoma, in April 2020, during the first weeks of the COVID-19 pandemic, after her roommate says Galloway tested positive for COVID and was instructed to quarantine. Nine months later, her remains are discovered one hundred miles away in Mena, Arkansas.
